name: PT HATTEN BALI Tbk
summary: Based in Bali, Indonesia, PT Hatten Bali Tbk specializes in the production and distribution of grape wines throughout the Indonesian market. Established in 1994, the company offers its viticultural products under a portfolio of brands, which includes Hatten Wines, TWO Islands, Dragonfly Wines, and Dewi Sri. PT Hatten Bali Tbk functions as a subsidiary entity of PT Gotama Putra.
